name: service-engagement
description: Configure Service Cloud digital engagement and Agentforce service channels: set up messaging and chat channels (including Enhanced Messaging channel creation, activation, consent, and routing), configure channel deployments, integrate a messaging site or WhatsApp Business Account, configure Email-to-Case, wire an Agentforce channel to an existing agent (including human-escalation handoff), and coordinate a help agent. Use when setting up customer-facing service channels — web chat, messaging, WhatsApp, email-to-case, digital engagement deployments, or an Agentforce service/help agent channel.

interface.shortDescription: Configure Service Cloud digital engagement and Agentforce service channels
